title: The Vitamin Your Body Cannot function without #VitaminB5#HealthTips#NutritionFacts
description:
"There's a vitamin your body uses every second of the day — and most people have never heard of it. It's Vitamin B5, also called Pantothenic Acid.
Your body needs it to turn food into energy, make hormones, keep your skin hydrated, and support your nervous system.
Low on B5? You might notice fatigue, brain fog, dry skin, or mood swings.
The good news — it's in foods like avocado, eggs, mushrooms, and sunflower seeds. Easy to add to your day.
Drop a 💊 if you're going to look this one up!"
